description: Error chain: runtime imports a contract module absent from the deployed wheel. Manifests as ImportError for omnimarket.models.evidence_pipeline at startup. OMN-12660.
trigger: Runtime container's wheel does not include a contract module referenced by a handler at import time

observable_event.when: handler module import during node startup

failure_mode: Node fails to start; handler not registered in DI container; consumer group absent from bus; upstream publish silently dropped
expected_error_path: node startup failure — no consumer group registered
regression_guard: If the deployed wheel does not contain the module, the node must fail at startup with a typed ImportError, not silently drop events
source_check: omnimarket.models.evidence_pipeline must exist in deployed image; verify with: python -c 'import omnimarket.models.evidence_pipeline'
